description: This is a PHP source code file defining a controller class for handling 'Information' pages in the OpenCart catalog module. It contains methods for displaying information pages and their details, including loading models, setting page metadata, breadcrumbs, and rendering views.

classes.name: Information
classes.description: Controller class for handling information pages in the OpenCart catalog module. Provides methods for displaying individual information pages and their details.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles display of an information page based on 'information_id' parameter. Loads language, model, sets metadata, breadcrumbs, page content, and renders the view. Returns an Action if page is found, or redirects to an error page.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Handles AJAX or specialized requests for information details. Similar to index but used for detailed view or API responses, setting headers and rendering the info view.
